title: OSD UAP records - 03_2024_DGI_Mission_Brief
doc_notes: This document is a mission brief from the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) dated February 2024, outlining the office's mission, operational framework, and strategic goals regarding UAP, but it contains no specific incident reports. / This document is an AARO mission brief outlining the analytic framework, peer-review processes, and methodology for investigating UAP reports. / This document is an AARO mission brief from March 2024 discussing analytic trends, data limitations, and reporting biases regarding UAP sightings. / This document is an AARO mission brief page describing a 2022 UAP sighting in the Middle East. / This document contains AARO case summaries for two UAP incidents, noting that both were resolved as commercial aircraft and sensor artifacts.

incidents.summary: MQ-9 drone observed a spherical UAP in the Middle East via electro-optical sensors.
incidents.explanation: Case in active archive, pending additional data.
incidents.quote: MQ-9 OBSERVED APPARENT SPHERICAL UAP VIA ELECTRO-OPTICAL SENSORS

incidents.summary: P-3 aircraft on a training mission in the Western United States observed three equidistant UAP that it was unable to intercept.
incidents.explanation: Likely commercial aircraft transiting known flight paths and video autofocus effect.
incidents.quote: Three UAP objects observed, apparently flying at high velocity.

incidents.summary: MQ-9 platform observed a UAP in South Asia with an apparent atmospheric wake.
incidents.explanation: Likely commercial airliner and video-compression artifact.
incidents.quote: South Asia UAP observed with apparent wake, likely resolved as commercial airliner
